5:1.sourceText: Καὶ εἶδον ἐπὶ τὴν δεξιὰν τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου βιβλίον γεγραμμένον ἔσωθεν καὶ ὄπισθεν, κατεσφραγισμένον σφραγῖσιν ἑπτά.
5:1.targetText: And I saw a scroll on the right hand of Him who is sitting on the throne, written within and on the back, sealed with seven seals;

groups.note: Actual dexian is accusative-feminine-singular right adjective used substantivally in the hand designation, expanded right-hand with its real A-ASF analyses retained; no independently printed Greek cheir/hand noun is invented.

Actual genitive-masculine-singular article nominalizes the sitting participle and supplies of-Him-who through case plus the personal substantive frame. No independently written Him/relative pronoun is asserted.
Actual kathēmenou is present nonactive genitive-masculine-singular sitting participle, rendered finite English is-sitting while retaining its actual participial form.
Actual gegrammenon is PERFECT PASSIVE accusative-neuter-singular writing participle, rendered written without an aorist or finite retag.
Actual opisthen is one back/behind adverb, expanded on-the-back without independently printed on/article/back noun source words.
Actual katesphragismenon is PERFECT PASSIVE accusative-neuter-singular sealing-up participle of katasphragizō, rendered sealed with its true compound head and perfect form retained.

Actual sphragisin is dative-feminine-plural seal noun, expanded with ... seals around the separate seven numeral through its instrumental nominal case; no independently written with preposition occurs.

5:2.sourceText: καὶ εἶδον ἄγγελον ἰσχυρὸν κηρύσσοντα ἐν φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Τίς ἄξιος ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ λῦσαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ;
5:2.targetText: and I saw a strong messenger crying with a great voice, “Who is worthy to open the scroll and to loose its seals?”

groups.note: Actual angelon is anarthrous accusative-masculine-singular messenger noun, expanded a ... messenger around its actual strong adjective without an independently printed indefinite article.

Actual kēryssonta is present active accusative-masculine-singular proclaiming/heralding participle, rendered crying in the voiced-announcement frame. The actual kēryssō head remains rather than a krazo crying verb substituted.
Actual phōnē is anarthrous dative-feminine-singular voice noun under actual en, expanded a ... voice around its actual great adjective without a source indefinite article.
Actual anoixai is aorist active opening infinitive, distinct from the following real loosening infinitive.
Actual lysai is aorist active loosening infinitive, rendered to-loose with its genuine lyō head.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual seals article is not separately expressed beside the English possessive its-seals phrase.

unmappedTarget.reason: English is follows the actual estin finite written in complete printed TR. Actual N1904 has a nominal Who-worthy question without a separately written being verb.

5:3.sourceText: καὶ οὐδεὶς ἐδύνατο ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ οὐδὲ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς οὐδὲ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό.
5:3.targetText: And no one was able in Heaven, nor on the earth, nor under the earth, to open the scroll, nor to behold it.

groups.note: Actual oudeis is one negative nominative-masculine-singular indefinite adjective used personally, expanded no-one without independent negative/person words.
Actual edynato is IMPERFECT nonactive/deponent third-singular ability finite, expanded was-able without a separate source being verb or able adjective.
Actual hypokatō is recorded ADV in both fields and rendered under in its local genitive earth relation; no source hypo preposition is substituted.
Actual oute is the final negative connective, rendered nor with its true source head retained; complete printed TR has oude at this occurrence.
Actual blepein is PRESENT ACTIVE beholding infinitive, distinct from the earlier aorist opening infinitive.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual Heaven article is not separately expressed in the English bare place designation.

5:4.sourceText: καὶ ἔκλαιον πολὺ, ὅτι οὐδεὶς ἄξιος εὑρέθη ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον οὔτε βλέπειν αὐτό.
5:4.targetText: And I was weeping much, because no one was found worthy to open and to read the scroll, nor to behold it,

groups.note: Actual eklaion is IMPERFECT ACTIVE first-singular weeping finite, expanded I-was-weeping with its encoded subject. The independently printed TR egō is not a missing N subject identity.
Actual poly is ACCUSATIVE NEUTER SINGULAR adjective used for extent, rendered much with its A-ASN analyses retained; complete printed TR has plural polla, and no adverb retag is imposed.
Actual heurethē is AORIST PASSIVE third-singular finding finite, expanded was-found. Worthy remains the separately actual axios adjective, not a part of this source verb.

unmappedTarget.reason: This whole extra reading clause follows kai/anagnōnai in complete printed TR. Actual N1904 has no independently written connective or reading predicate between open and the-scroll; opening/beholding are their own real different lexical heads.

5:5.sourceText: καὶ εἷς ἐκ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων λέγει μοι Μὴ κλαῖε· ἰδοὺ ἐνίκησεν ὁ Λέων ὁ ἐκ τῆς φυλῆς Ἰούδα, ἡ Ῥίζα Δαυείδ, ἀνοῖξαι τὸ βιβλίον καὶ τὰς ἑπτὰ σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ.
5:5.targetText: and one of the elders says to me, “Do not weep; behold, the Lion of the tribe of Judah, the root of David, has overcome to open the scroll, and to loose its seven seals”;

groups.note: Actual presbyterōn is genitive-masculine-plural COMPARATIVE elder adjective used personally, rendered elders with A-GPM-C retained rather than retagged noun.
Actual moi is dative first-singular recipient of says, expanded to-me through case without a separately written to preposition.
Actual klaie is PRESENT ACTIVE second-singular weeping imperative, expanded Do ... weep around the actual negative; no independent Greek do auxiliary occurs.
Actual enikēsen is AORIST ACTIVE third-singular overcoming finite, rendered English perfect has-overcome without a perfect source retag.
Actual ek with the tribe genitive is rendered of, retaining the real preposition rather than a bare genitive source alone.
Actual Iouda is recorded genitive-masculine-singular Judah name, expanded of-Judah through its real nominal relation/case.
Actual David is indeclinable N-PRI proper name in the root qualification, expanded of-David without demanding an unrecorded coded genitive or separate of source word.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual repeated article before the tribe qualification is not separately expressed in the English Lion-of-the-tribe phrase; no independently printed N being participle occurs there.
The actual seals article is not separately expressed beside the English possessive its-seven-seals.

unmappedTarget.reason: English to-loose follows the additional lysai infinitive in complete printed TR. Actual N1904 has only the distinct opening infinitive before the coordinated seals object; no N loosening lemma or second infinitive is invented.

5:6.sourceText: Καὶ εἶδον ἐν μέσῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν τεσσάρων ζῴων καὶ ἐν μέσῳ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων Ἀρνίον ἑστηκὸς ὡς ἐσφαγμένον, ἔχων κέρατα ἑπτὰ καὶ ὀφθαλμοὺς ἑπτά, οἵ εἰσιν τὰ ἑπτὰ Πνεύματα τοῦ Θεοῦ ἀπεσταλμένοι εἰς πᾶσαν τὴν γῆν.
5:6.targetText: and I saw, and behold, in the midst of the throne, and of the four living creatures, and in the midst of the elders, a Lamb standing as having been slain, having seven horns and seven eyes, which are the Seven Spirits of God, which are sent to all the earth,

groups.note: Actual mesō is dative-neuter-singular middle adjective used substantivally under en, expanded the-midst with A-DSN retained, not a source noun retag or independent article.
The second actual mesō is its own dative-neuter-singular substantive adjective occurrence and owns only the second the-midst.
Actual presbyterōn is genitive-masculine-plural comparative adjective used personally, rendered elders without a noun retag.
Actual hestēkos is PERFECT ACTIVE accusative-neuter-singular standing participle, rendered standing with its perfect/source form retained, not a source present.
Actual esphagmenon is PERFECT PASSIVE accusative-neuter-singular slaying participle, expanded having-been-slain without separately written having/being auxiliaries.

Actual echōn is PRESENT ACTIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE SINGULAR having participle, although the Lamb noun is accusative neuter. Complete printed TR has neuter echon; actual N form is retained without an agreement repair or identification of a new actor.
Actual hoi is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL relative, rendered the first which with its real gender and occurrence preserved, distinct from the neuter Spirit noun phrase.
Actual genitive article/God jointly owns of-God as the nominal case head, retaining actual source order after Spirits rather than the TR order before it.

Actual apestalmenoi is PERFECT PASSIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL sending participle, expanded are-sent with its real perfect/masculine form retained. Complete printed TR has neuter plural apestalmena with article; no present finite or gender retag is inferred from English.

unmappedTarget.reason: Displayed LSV and-behold follows the additional kai/idou after I-saw in complete printed TR. Actual N1904 has no independently printed conjunction/behold at that position.

This final English relative frame follows the nominalizing ta before the sent participle in complete printed TR. Actual N1904 directly prints the sent participle without a second independent article or relative here; the earlier actual hoi owns the earlier which.

5:7.sourceText: καὶ ἦλθεν καὶ εἴληφεν ἐκ τῆς δεξιᾶς τοῦ καθημένου ἐπὶ τοῦ θρόνου.
5:7.targetText: and He came and took the scroll out of the right hand of Him who is sitting on the throne.

groups.note: Actual ēlthen is second-aorist active third-singular coming finite, expanded He-came with its grammatically encoded subject, not an independently written He pronoun.
Actual eilēphen is SECOND-PERFECT ACTIVE third-singular receiving/taking finite, rendered past English took. Its actual perfect and lambanō head remain, not an aorist retag.
Actual dexias is genitive-feminine-singular right adjective used substantivally for the hand, expanded right-hand with A-GSF retained and no separately printed cheir noun.
Actual genitive-masculine-singular article nominalizes the sitting participle and supplies of-Him-who through case and personal nominalization, without an independent pronoun or relative.
Actual kathēmenou is present nonactive genitive-masculine-singular sitting participle, rendered is-sitting without a finite being source.

unmappedTarget.reason: Complete printed TR explicitly prints to-biblion here, reflected by LSV the-scroll. Actual N1904 has no locally printed scroll noun in this verse. The separately printed verse8 scroll occurrence remains anchored at its actual verse; it is not borrowed backward to conceal this documented local source-reading difference.

5:8.sourceText: Καὶ ὅτε ἔλαβεν τὸ βιβλίον, τὰ τέσσερα ζῷα καὶ οἱ εἴκοσι τέσσαρες πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Ἀρνίου, ἔχοντες ἕκαστος κιθάραν καὶ φιάλας χρυσᾶς γεμούσας θυμιαμάτων, αἵ εἰσιν αἱ προσευχαὶ τῶν ἁγίων.
5:8.targetText: And when He took the scroll, the four living creatures and the twenty-four elders fell before the Lamb, each one having harps and golden bowls full of incenses, which are the prayers of the holy ones,

groups.note: Actual hote is recorded ADV in both fields, rendered when with its real temporal source identity retained.
Actual elaben is SECOND-AORIST ACTIVE third-singular taking predicate, expanded He-took with its grammatically encoded subject. It remains distinct from the perfect-taking predicate at verse7.
Actual presbyteroi is nominative-masculine-plural comparative adjective used personally, rendered elders without a noun retag.
Actual echontes is PRESENT ACTIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL having participle, while the following each is singular; the actual source number/case remain, not an English-driven singular tag.
Actual hekastos is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE SINGULAR each adjective used personally, expanded each-one without a separately printed one numeral or person noun.

Actual kitharan is ACCUSATIVE FEMININE SINGULAR harp noun, rendered plural English harps following complete printed TR kitharas. The shared harp lexical head is retained with the actual singular analysis explicit, not retagged plural.
Actual gemousas is PRESENT ACTIVE accusative-feminine-plural fullness participle qualifying bowls, rendered full with its real gemō verbal head rather than a plērēs adjective.
Actual thymiamatōn is genitive-neuter-plural incense noun complementing the fullness participle, expanded of-incenses with its real nominal case retained.
Actual genitive article/holy adjective jointly forms the substantive holy-person group, expanded of-the-holy-ones without independently printed one/person nouns.

5:9.sourceText: καὶ ᾄδουσιν ᾠδὴν καινὴν λέγοντες Ἄξιος εἶ λαβεῖν τὸ βιβλίον καὶ ἀνοῖξαι τὰς σφραγῖδας αὐτοῦ, ὅτι ἐσφάγης καὶ ἠγόρασας τῷ Θεῷ ἐν τῷ αἵματί σου ἐκ πάσης φυλῆς καὶ γλώσσης καὶ λαοῦ καὶ ἔθνους,
5:9.targetText: and they sing a new song, saying, “Worthy are You to take the scroll, and to open its seals, because You were slain, and You purchased us to God in Your blood, out of every tribe, and tongue, and people, and nation,

groups.note: Actual adousin is PRESENT ACTIVE third-plural singing finite, expanded they-sing with its encoded subject and actual adō head.
Actual legontes is PRESENT ACTIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL saying participle; its actual gender/case remain despite preceding neuter living-creature wording.
Actual ei is PRESENT ACTIVE second-singular being finite, expanded are-You with its encoded subject, distinct from the slaying and purchase subjects encoded in their own finites.
Actual esphagēs is SECOND-AORIST PASSIVE second-singular slaying finite, expanded You-were-slain with its actual passive retained.
Actual ēgorasas is AORIST ACTIVE second-singular purchasing finite, expanded You-purchased with its actual agorazō head, not an invented redeeming lemma.
Actual dative article/God jointly supplies to-God as the recipient nominal case head, without an independent to preposition.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual seals article is not separately expressed beside its-seals in English.
The actual blood article is not separately expressed beside Your-blood in English.

unmappedTarget.reason: English us follows the extra hēmas purchase-object pronoun printed in complete TR. Actual N1904 does not print that first-plural object here; the third-person autous in verse10 has a different person and is not borrowed or retagged.

5:10.sourceText: καὶ ἐποίησας αὐτοὺς τῷ Θεῷ ἡμῶν βασιλείαν καὶ ἱερεῖς, καὶ βασιλεύσουσιν ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς.
5:10.targetText: and made them [to be] to our God kings and priests, and they will reign on the earth.”

groups.note: Actual epoiēsas is AORIST ACTIVE second-singular making finite with its actual personal object and result nouns, rendered made ... [to-be] as the English make-result construction. No separately printed Greek eimi infinitive or additional source predicate is asserted.

Actual autous is ACCUSATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL third-person object, rendered them with its real identity retained. Complete printed TR instead has first-plural hēmas, but displayed LSV follows the actual N third-person object.
Actual dative article/God jointly owns to ... God around the separate actual our possessor, retaining the nominal case head without a bare article assigned only to.

Actual basileusousin is FUTURE ACTIVE THIRD-PLURAL reigning finite, expanded they-will-reign. Complete printed TR has FIRST-PLURAL basileusomen; actual N person/encoded subject remain, not a first-person retag.

unmappedSource.reason: Actual basileian is ACCUSATIVE FEMININE SINGULAR kingdom noun. Complete printed TR instead has basileis kings, followed by English kings; the distinct kingdom/king personal noun heads remain an explicit lexical witness gap, not a Strong-family equivalence.

unmappedTarget.reason: English kings follows the basileis personal plural noun printed in complete TR. Actual N1904 prints singular basileian kingdom; the unlike nominal head is not falsely assigned to a king lemma or retagged plural.

5:11.sourceText: καὶ εἶδον, καὶ ἤκουσα φωνὴν ἀγγέλων πολλῶν κύκλῳ τοῦ θρόνου καὶ τῶν ζῴων καὶ τῶν πρεσβυτέρων, καὶ ἦν ὁ ἀριθμὸς αὐτῶν μυριάδες μυριάδων καὶ χιλιάδες χιλιάδων,
5:11.targetText: And I saw, and I heard the voice of many messengers around the throne, and the living creatures, and the elders—and the number of them was myriads of myriads, and thousands of thousands—

groups.note: Actual phōnēn is anarthrous accusative-feminine-singular voice noun, expanded the-voice without an independently printed Greek article.
Actual angelōn is genitive-masculine-plural messenger noun, expanded of ... messengers around its separate actual many modifier.

Actual kyklō is recorded N-DSM in both fields and rendered around through its circle/surrounding use. Complete printed TR has kyklothen adverb; no adverb retag or different source preposition is imposed.
Actual presbyterōn is genitive-masculine-plural comparative adjective used personally, rendered elders with both A-GPM-C analyses retained.
Actual ēn is the independently printed IMPERFECT ACTIVE third-singular being finite and owns English was in the number expression; it is not assigned to a nearby noun or adjective.
Actual autōn is genitive-masculine-plural possessor of the number noun, expanded of-them with its real case and person retained.

Actual myriades is NOMINATIVE FEMININE PLURAL myriad/ten-thousand noun; the next actual genitive occurrence owns of-myriads. The entire number/myriad frame is printed in actual N although omitted in the shorter complete TR here, and displayed LSV retains it.
Actual myriadōn is the separate GENITIVE FEMININE PLURAL myriad noun, expanded of-myriads through case, not a second target of the preceding nominative noun.
Actual chiliadōn is GENITIVE FEMININE PLURAL thousand noun, expanded of-thousands, distinct from the preceding actual nominative plural thousands occurrence.

5:12.sourceText: λέγοντες φωνῇ μεγάλῃ Ἄξιός ἐστιν τὸ Ἀρνίον τὸ ἐσφαγμένον λαβεῖν τὴν δύναμιν καὶ πλοῦτον καὶ σοφίαν καὶ ἰσχὺν καὶ τιμὴν καὶ δόξαν καὶ εὐλογίαν.
5:12.targetText: saying with a great voice, “Worthy is the Lamb that was slain to receive the power, and riches, and wisdom, and strength, and honor, and glory, and blessing!”

groups.note: Actual legontes is PRESENT ACTIVE NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL saying participle, retaining its actual case despite genitive messenger wording in the prior verse; no finite source says is substituted.

Actual phōnē is anarthrous DATIVE FEMININE SINGULAR voice noun, expanded with-a ... voice around the separate great adjective by instrumental case. No independently printed with preposition or indefinite article occurs.

Actual axios is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE SINGULAR worthy adjective in both raw fields, although the Lamb noun is neuter; complete printed TR has neuter axion. Actual N masculine analysis is retained without agreement correction.
Actual nominative-neuter-singular article introduces the slaying participle qualifier and owns English that, not a separately printed source relative.

Actual esphagmenon is PERFECT PASSIVE nominative-neuter-singular slaying participle, rendered finite English was-slain with its true perfect/participial source form retained, distinct from the actual eimi finite before Lamb.
Actual plouton is ACCUSATIVE MASCULINE SINGULAR riches/wealth noun, rendered English riches with its real singular analysis retained.

5:13.sourceText: καὶ πᾶν κτίσμα ὃ ἐν τῷ οὐρανῷ καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς γῆς καὶ ὑποκάτω τῆς γῆς καὶ ἐπὶ τῆς θαλάσσης ἐστίν, καὶ τὰ ἐν αὐτοῖς πάντα, ἤκουσα λέγοντας Τῷ καθημένῳ ἐπὶ τῷ θρόνῳ καὶ τῷ Ἀρνίῳ ἡ εὐλογία καὶ ἡ τιμὴ καὶ ἡ δόξα καὶ τὸ κράτος εἰς τοὺς αἰῶνας τῶν αἰώνων.
5:13.targetText: And every creature that is in Heaven, and on the earth, and under the earth, and the things that are on the sea, and all things in them, I heard saying, “To Him who is sitting on the throne and to the Lamb—the blessing, and the honor, and the glory, and the might—through the ages of the ages!”

groups.note: Actual pan is ACCUSATIVE NEUTER SINGULAR every adjective modifying actual ktisma, not the later plural panta source occurrence.
Actual ho is NOMINATIVE NEUTER SINGULAR relative introducing the coordinated locative description of the actual singular creature noun, rendered the first that with its actual number/case retained.
Actual hypokatō is recorded ADV in both fields, rendered under before its genitive earth complement, not a source hypo preposition.

Actual estin is the one PRESENT ACTIVE THIRD-SINGULAR being finite after the coordinated Heaven/earth/under-earth/sea locatives. English repeats is and are through that same immediate locative enumeration, retaining one actual source identity and the real singular source form; complete printed TR prints two estins. No second N being verb is invented, and the extra sea-member nominal/relative frame is separately explained.

Actual accusative-neuter-plural article substantivizes the in-them/all construction and owns the second things. No independently printed thing noun is invented; the extra earlier sea-member the-things frame remains distinct.

Actual legontas is PRESENT ACTIVE ACCUSATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL saying participle, retaining its actual gender/number despite the earlier singular-neuter ktisma noun. No source agreement or finite retag is imposed.

Actual dative-masculine-singular article nominalizes the sitting participle and owns To-Him-who through recipient case and its personal substantive frame, without independently written Him/relative pronouns.
Actual kathēmenō is PRESENT nonactive/deponent DATIVE MASCULINE SINGULAR sitting participle, rendered is-sitting without an independently printed source eimi finite.
Actual dative article/Lamb jointly owns to-the-Lamb through the recipient nominal case construction; no sole article assigned only to.
Actual genitive-plural article owns of-the before the separately written final ages noun, conveying case plus definiteness without a bare-preposition-only article link.

unmappedSource.reason: The actual Heaven article is not separately expressed in the English bare place designation.

unmappedTarget.reason: This English plural nominal/relative frame at the sea member follows the separately printed ha relative in complete TR. Actual N1904 continues the existing creature/relative locative enumeration without another independent nominalizing article, thing noun or plural relative at that point; no source pronoun is invented.

5:14.sourceText: καὶ τὰ τέσσερα ζῷα ἔλεγον Ἀμήν, καὶ οἱ πρεσβύτεροι ἔπεσαν καὶ προσεκύνησαν.
5:14.targetText: And the four living creatures said, “Amen!” And the twenty-four elders fell down and they worship Him who is living through the ages of the ages.

groups.note: Actual elegon is IMPERFECT ACTIVE third-plural saying finite, rendered simple past English said with its real imperfect retained.
Actual Amēn has HEB in both pinned fields and owns the printed Amen expression, not a guessed Greek noun.
Actual presbyteroi is NOMINATIVE MASCULINE PLURAL comparative adjective used personally, rendered elders with actual A-NPM-C preserved, not retagged noun.
Actual epesan is SECOND-AORIST ACTIVE third-plural falling predicate, expanded fell-down without a separately printed down adverb.

Actual prosekynēsan is AORIST ACTIVE third-plural prostrating/worshiping finite, expanded present English they-worship with its encoded subject and actual aorist retained; no source present retag or independently printed they pronoun is inferred.

unmappedTarget.reason: English twenty-four follows the explicit numeral compound in complete printed TR before elders. Actual N1904 prints only the elder designation there; earlier count numerals are not borrowed into this verse.
